question: What was the theme of the 9th International Maritime Security Conference (IMSC) organised by the Republic of Singapore in May 2025?

options.text: Navigating New Horizons in Maritime Innovation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Safe and Secure Seas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **9th International Maritime Security Conference (IMSC)** was held in **May 2025**, organized by the **Republic of Singapore**.
 
• The theme of the conference was **“Safe and Secure Seas”**, focusing on the importance of maritime security and collaboration in ensuring freedom of navigation and protection of maritime trade routes.
 
• This theme highlighted global concerns around **piracy, maritime terrorism, and illegal activities** in international waters, emphasizing the need for cooperation among nations.
 
• The IMSC brought together **naval chiefs, policymakers, and maritime industry leaders** to discuss evolving challenges and strategies for maintaining maritime peace and security.
 
• The conference served as a platform to reinforce commitments to **international maritime laws** and promote regional stability through collaborative measures.
